mapper.insert: INSERT INTO responses ( survey_id, username, trace_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{surveyId}, #{username}, #{traceId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE responses SET survey_id = #{surveyId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
